translations.web: The priest said to them, “Go in peace. Your way in which you go is before Yahweh.”
translations.bsb: And the priest told them, “Go in peace. The LORD is watching over your journey.”
translations.kjv: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.
translations.asv: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before Jehovah is your way wherein ye go.
